In this question, a statement and related two conclusions have been given in the form of i and ii. You have to consider both the conclusions as truths in the statements together and to decide which conclusions regarding the statements Rational beyond any reasonable doubt.

**Statement:** Statement: Government is supplying free medicines from 2014 and till now 75 thousand sick people have taken advantage of it, although the size of affected population is 100 times this number.

**Conclusion:**

i) Every affected person has taken advantage of the free medicines given by the government.

ii) The scheme implemented by the Government of India for giving free medicines to the affected people is very good.

Select the one most suitable in the following options:

A. The only conclusion i is logical is

B. only the conclusions ii is logical

C. Either the conclusions i or ii is rational

D. Neither conclusion i nor conclusion ii is rational.

E. i and ii both conclusions are rational.
questions.solution:
The given statement mentions that the government has been supplying free medicines since 2014, and 75 thousand sick people have taken advantage of it. However, the size of the affected population is 100 times this number, which means that only a small fraction of the affected people have taken advantage of the free medicines.

**Conclusion i) **Every affected person has taken advantage of the free medicines given by the government is not logical as the statement clearly states that only 75 thousand sick people have taken advantage of the free medicines, whereas the size of the affected population is much larger. Therefore, this conclusion is not rational.

**Conclusion ii) **The scheme implemented by the Government of India for giving free medicines to the affected people is very good is not directly supported by the given statement. While the statement mentions that the government is supplying free medicines, it does not provide any information about the quality or effectiveness of the scheme. Therefore, this conclusion is also not entirely rational.

Thus,** neither conclusion i nor conclusion ii** can be considered completely rational beyond any reasonable doubt based on the given statement.

**Hence, the answer is option D, "Neither conclusion i nor conclusion ii is rational."**

37 × 2 + 1 = **75.**

Hence, the missing number is **75.**

questions.question: In context of monetary policy, the sacrifice ratio refers to the _________

options.text: Interest cost arising because of crowding out effect
Loss of real value of money at the face of increasing inflation

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The sacrifice ratio is a measure of the economic output that must be forgone to reduce inflation by one percentage point. It is calculated by dividing the percentage point reduction in inflation by the percentage point decline in real GDP.
 
• Monetary policy is used to control inflation by raising or lowering interest rates. When the central bank raises interest rates, it makes it more expensive for businesses to borrow money, which can lead to a decrease in investment and economic growth. The sacrifice ratio is a way of measuring the trade-off between reducing inflation and maintaining economic growth.

questions.question: Most of India's rainfall is ________
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is 'Orographic'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Orographic Rainfall in India:**

 
 
• Most of India’s rainfall is of the **orographic type**, caused when moisture-laden monsoon winds rise over mountain ranges like the Western Ghats and the Himalayas.
 
• The uplift of air results in cooling, condensation, and heavy rainfall on the windward side of mountains.
 
• Areas such as the Western coastal belt and the northeastern states (Meghalaya, Assam) experience intense orographic rainfall.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cyclonic Rainfall:**

 
 
• Occurs mainly in northwestern India during winter due to **western disturbances**.
 
• It is important for the Rabi crop cycle but contributes only a small share to the overall rainfall.
 
 
 
• **Convectional Rainfall:**
 
 
• Occurs locally during hot summer afternoons, especially in the plateau regions.
 
• It is short-lived but often accompanied by thunderstorms, locally known as **Kalbaisakhi** in West Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Contribution of Orographic Rainfall:**
 
 
• Over **75% of India’s annual rainfall** comes from the South-West monsoon, dominated by orographic processes.
 
• **Mawsynram** and **Cherrapunji** receive the world’s highest rainfall due to this effect.

• In a planned economy, the government typically controls key industries, sets prices, and determines the allocation of resources.
 
• This contrasts with a market economy, where decisions are driven by market forces such as supply and demand.

questions.question: Which three tropical cyclones were simultaneously active in the South Pacific in February 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rae, Seru, Alfred.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Satellite imagery revealed that three tropical cyclones—Rae, Seru, and Alfred—were simultaneously active in the South Pacific in February 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The three cyclones developed within five days, covering an area of approximately 8,000 km.**
 
• Cyclone Alfred intensified rapidly to Category 3, with wind gusts of 185 km/h in the Coral Sea.
 
• Cyclone Rae, forming north of Fiji, caused significant damage with strong winds and heavy rainfall.
 
• Climate change and the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) contributed to the unexpected cyclone activity during a La Niña phase.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **La Niña and Cyclone Activity**__

 __
 
• La Niña typically results in cooler ocean temperatures, reducing tropical storm formation.
 
• Scientists had predicted fewer cyclones, but the presence of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) altered conditions.
 
 
 
• **Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO)**__
 __
 
• A climate phenomenon that creates zones of rising air and increased rainfall, moving globally every 30 days.
 
• It contributed to unexpected cyclone activity in the South Pacific in early 2025.
 
 
 
• **Previous Instances of Triple Cyclones**__
 
 
• The last recorded instance of three simultaneous cyclones in the South Pacific occurred in January 2021 (Lucas, Ana, Bina).
 
• Such events are rare and highlight the complexity of weather systems.

• The Fundamental Duties are moral obligations of all citizens to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India.
 
• There are 11 Fundamental Duties listed in the Indian Constitution.
 
• These duties emphasize the importance of a responsible citizenry in maintaining the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of the nation.

• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**
 
 
• This amendment is also known as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its wide-ranging impact.
 
• It was enacted during the Emergency period by the Indira Gandhi government.
 
• In addition to the introduction of Fundamental Duties, it also brought significant changes to the Preamble, the Seventh Schedule, and the Union-State relations.
 
• This amendment aimed to give more power to the central government and reduce the autonomy of the states.
 
 
 
• **Part IV-A of the Constitution**
 
 
• This part was added by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• It contains Article 51A, which enumerates the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens.
 
• Part IV-A serves as a reminder that the citizens also have certain duties towards the nation, in addition to enjoying their rights.
 
 
 
• **Article 51A**
 
 
• This article lists the Fundamental Duties of every citizen of India.
 
• It includes duties such as abiding by the Constitution, promoting harmony, and safeguarding public property.
 
• Although these duties are not enforceable by law, they are considered essential for the promotion of a sense of discipline and commitment among citizens.

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 134° at the centre of the circle. The chord AB is produced to a point P. ∠CBP is equal to:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle subtended by an arc at the major arc is half of the angle subtended at the centre.

⇒ Interior opposite angle = 134° ÷ 2 = 67°.

For any cyclic quadrilateral, the exterior angle is directly equal to the interior opposite angle.

⇒ ∠CBP = Interior opposite angle = 67°.

**∴ The correct answer is 67°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

∠AOC = 134° (Angle subtended by arc ABC at the centre)

AB is produced to P

**Formula Used:**

Angle subtended at circumference = Angle at centre ÷ 2

Sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral = 180°

Angles on a straight line add up to 180°

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let D be a point on the major arc AC. Points A, B, C, and D form a cyclic quadrilateral.

⇒ The angle subtended by arc AC at the centre is ∠AOC = 134°.

⇒ The angle subtended by the same arc at the major arc is ∠ADC.

⇒ ∠ADC = ∠AOC ÷ 2

⇒ ∠ADC = 134° ÷ 2 = 67°

⇒ Since ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of its opposite angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC + 67° = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 180° − 67° = 113°

⇒ Line segment ABP is a straight line, so angles ∠ABC and ∠CBP form a linear pair.

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠CBP = 180°

⇒ 113° + ∠CBP = 180°

⇒ ∠CBP = 180° − 113° = 67°

**∴ The correct answer is 67°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle at Centre Theorem

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any remaining part of the circle.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

A quadrilateral whose all four vertices lie on a circle is called a cyclic quadrilateral. The sum of either pair of opposite angles is exactly 180°.

Exterior Angle Property

If one side of a cyclic quadrilateral is produced, the exterior angle so formed is equal to the interior opposite angle. In this question directly, ∠CBP = ∠ADC = 67°.

• Indefinite article 'an': before a singular noun beginning with a vowel sound whose specific identity is not known
